observations: Photo 0 shows a black gas cooker with a glass top cover, four burners, five control knobs, and a brand name 'ATLAS' on the front panel. The oven door is closed.

Photo 1 shows the same cooker with the glass top removed, revealing four burners (two large, two small) and the oven door open, showing oven racks and a grilling tray. The brand 'ATLAS' is visible on the front panel.
The cooker has a black finish with a textured pattern on the oven door and a silver handle.
The setting appears to be outdoors on a paved surface, possibly a yard or patio.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI RUNATECHS NIG LTD' on both photos.
